verdict.rationale: Bolt documents a Visual edits feature for changing how a project looks directly in the preview, and Code view direct edits are free and use no tokens, so manual edits are possible without a prompt round-trip. The visual-edits evidence is a single line, though, and does not spell out element selection or which properties can be changed. Missing for 10: documented click-to-select element workflow, explicit coverage of text, style and layout edits, confirmation that visual edits bypass the AI/token round-trip, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
